label: დღის ციფრი
about: The Number of the Day: one striking number the articles state, what it counts and what it means, in 20-25 s.
brief: This is the rubric „The Number of the Day“: the video is about one number the articles state.
The hook says the number and what it counts in 2-3 short lines; the next scene shows it (stat, change, share or compare).
Then 1-2 scenes that say when, where or why, with facts from the articles; then the end card.
20-25 seconds: about 26-32 narration words, sentences of 6-12 words.
Never round, compute or compare a number the articles don't state; never add an opinion about it.
